contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Copy Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Diademed bust right, with thick lips and bulbous nose. Obverse inscription: [--]PE AV[--], blundered. Reverse description: Possibly soldier spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [F]EL T[EMP REPARATIO].
